title: Von Neumann Type Inequalities for NC Operator Balls
summary: We establish finite-dimensional von Neumann type inequalities for commuting matrix tuples in noncommutative operator balls. Let $Ω=\mathbb{D}_Q$ be the NC operator ball of a linear pencil $Q$ with linearly independent coefficients.
